Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.

entry.title: Roman baths (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that two headless white marble statues found in Amman's Roman baths (pictured) in 2020 were carved from stone quarried in Greece?

entry.title: Holy Cross Church (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Holy Cross Church in Kentucky was built on land donated by the namesake of a brand of whiskey?

entry.title: Kanailal Sarkar (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Kanailal Sarkar, the opposition candidate for mayor of Calcutta in 1963, had been jailed during the 1930 protest movement against British rule in India?

entry.title: Pieter Vanden Bos (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Canadian football player Pieter Vanden Bos was traded from the Roughriders to the Rough Riders?

entry.title: catchy, often gruesome rhymes (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that workers in European lace workshops and schools chanted catchy, often gruesome rhymes?

entry.title: Soséfo Makapé Papilio (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the tenure of Wallis and Futuna's longest-serving senator, Soséfo Makapé Papilio, ended when he was found dead in a car submerged in the sea?

entry.title: an ancient relative (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that velvet worms had an ancient relative with two pairs of antennae?

entry.title: American Samoa at the 2024 Summer Olympics (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that both athletes for American Samoa at the 2024 Summer Olympics represented the territory because their relatives were born there?
